text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day in early February—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Katsuragi Ace and I had come to watch the 
Kyodo News Hai, where Mr. C.B. was 
running.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—She's cornered Mr. C.B.!! Neck and neck, 
and they cross the finish line!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Incredible...! Coming all the way from the 
back in one go...!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Man, CB really is the real deal! I'm so 
begging her to go for the Triple Crown!!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
C.B. was so cool, wasn't she... I just 
can't take my eyes off her...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Mmm-mmph...! That was such a good race...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
That guy... after running a race like 
that, how can she look so unbothered 
already...?!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"CB! That was so cool! Good luck next time 
too! We're rooting for you!!"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Thanks.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...I'm glad I got to see it in person.
choice_data_list: Ace, how did CB look to you?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"In a word... 'astounding' is how it 
feels."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"...I already knew she was an amazing 
Umamusume, but she's still got an insane 
amount of potential left...!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"It really drove home the fact that the 
next time we race, you're gonna be even 
stronger than today, whether I like it or 
not."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I agreed with Katsuragi Ace's analysis. 
Today, I was once again reminded of Mr. 
C.B.'s immense potential...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: —But that's fine.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
It's precisely because she leaves common 
sense behind and charges far beyond 
everything, because she's Mr. C.B.—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: I feel a strong urge to surpass them...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Even after witnessing Mr. C.B.'s 
current strength firsthand, Katsuragi Ace 
doesn't seem overwhelmed in the 
slightest."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Far from it; you could say her competitive 
spirit is burning even more fiercely. It's 
truly reassuring...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Trainer. Do you mind if I go see 
C.B. for a bit?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
If I'm gonna fight CB, I really want to 
compete on the Classic Triple Crown 
route...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
So, I'm gonna tell them directly...! That 
I'm aiming for the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
So I'll get her even a little bit 
interested... and then show her how I run 
from now on to make her want to take me 
on!
choice_data_list: ...If that's the case, let's go see them!

...If that's the case, shall we go see 
them?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Alright! No time like the present, let's 
go!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: When I headed ahead to meet Mr. C.B.—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Murmur, murmur, murmur, murmur...)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
What is it? It's getting awfully noisy 
over there—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
—Thank you for your hard work in the Kyodo 
News Hai! That was a magnificent run...! 
How are you feeling about the Triple Crown 
path after this?

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
A run like that is sure to raise the fans' 
expectations! There's a massive demand to 
see her enter the Satsuki Sho—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Hmm. Let's see—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Trainer, sorry! Let me go right now!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
It's like a gut feeling, or...! I feel 
like if I don't tell them right now, the 
moment will pass, and I'll miss my 
chance...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Katsuragi Ace surely knows Mr. C.B.'s 
personality better than I do. If that's 
what her intuition tells her—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...! Thank you!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Cee Beeee!!!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
—If you're hesitating, then come to the 
Satsuki Sho!! And face me head-to-head!!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Ace—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Huh, isn't that... Katsuragi Ace? Why 
right now—

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
Don't stop filming...! This is gonna get 
interesting...!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Not just the Satsuki Sho! The Japanese 
Derby, and the Kikuka Sho, too!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
It's a best-of-three showdown between you 
and me in the Classic Triple Crown!!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: —Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Haha, ahahaha...!! Man, Ace really is 
something else...!!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Showing up out of the blue and dropping 
something like that on me..." attitude?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: —Sure, let's do it.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: I'm running the Classic Triple Crown too.

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: (Oooooohhh!?)

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
First is the Satsuki Sho— We settle things 
there, Ace.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Hell yeah! That's a promise!!

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
"Now that Mr. C.B.'s entry in the Classic 
Triple Crown is confirmed, Twinkle Series 
fans everywhere seem to be brimming with 
excitement!"

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
"Well, everyone was hoping for it. I'm 
sure many fans were relieved to hear it 
straight from her own mouth."

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
"I, too, have been looking forward to 
seeing what she can do, so I can't wait."

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
“Katsuragi Ace, who suddenly appeared and 
threw down the gauntlet to Mr. C.B., 
certainly gave quite the spirited speech, 
didn't she~?”

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Whoa! It really showed me on screen!!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
"She seems to be an up-and-coming 
Umamusume, but C.B. is likely several 
steps ahead of her. Though she threw down 
the gauntlet, will she truly—"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...Good grief. It's like you're saying I 
don't stand a chance from the start.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Even online, people keep saying I'm 'out 
of my depth' and all that, so—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Nah, it's more like, "Bring it on!" I'm 
used to being underestimated, anyway.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I'll show 'em all! Those guys looking down 
on me... and CB, too!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Heheh—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...Alright, let's get started today too! 
My warrior's journey is far from over, 
after all!
choice_data_list: Let's give it all we've got!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Oooooh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, a promise for a best-of-three 
match with Mr. C.B. was struck—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —A few days later.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Gaaah! It never eeeends!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(Getting so absorbed in training that I 
forgot my homework? Am I an idiot or 
what...?!)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(If I don't finish this today, it'll 
affect tomorrow's training...! Nwaaaah!!)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text: —Ah, there you are. Good work, Ace-chan.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
Heard you forgot your assignment, and wow, 
you really did! We'll give you a hand~

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Huh, seriously!? Honestly, that's a huge 
help...! Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: —Hell yeah! All done~!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, you two! Because of you, I can 
turn this in first thing tomorrow morning!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text: Fufu, you're welcome.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I'll definitely make it up to you next 
time! Wanna grab some food on me? Or 
maybe—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
"No, no~! In fact, this is our way of 
saying thanks!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text:
"...I saw the footage of you challenging 
CB-chan, Ace-chan."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
You know, what you did, S-cchi... it 
really encouraged all of us.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
Back when S-cchi first enrolled, to be 
totally blunt... she had a super rough 
time, didn't she?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
"Whaaat!? S-cchi, you do this much muscle 
training every single day!?"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Huh? Yeah. I mean, if I don't train hard, 
I won't be able to catch up, right?"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text:
""T-There's a limit to everything...! You 
need to rest properly and split up muscle 
groups! Resting is just as important when 
it comes to muscle training!""

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Huh...! No one's ever taught me stuff 
like that before. Mind if I hear a bit 
more about it?"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, that's fine, but... I see... So 
you never even got taught at a club, 
huh..."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
—Coming all the way to Tokyo alone and 
enrolling here... it felt like I was 
learning things everyone else already 
knew, over and over.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...Ah~. That reminds me of when someone 
saw me caring for my shoes my own way and 
using the same pair forever, and looked 
totally creeped out...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text:
And yet, Ace-chan didn't care about the 
differences between us or the other girls, 
and kept working hard without ever losing 
heart, ever since that time.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text: Look forward, keep moving forward—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text:
—We've finally made it to the point where 
we can stand at the pinnacle of our 
generation and say, 'Let's settle this.'

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text:
Seeing you stand tall without backing down 
an inch, even right in front of CB-chan, 
Ace-chan... you were so incredibly 
cool...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
“—And that made me think, 'We can't let 
ourselves lose either.'”

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
"It made me realize all over again that 
Esc-chi, who struggled the most out of all 
of us, kept working the hardest."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text:
That's why we have to do our best too, 
right where we are...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text: I realized... that I have to fight!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: You two...—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(It's different this time...! Those 
eyes... They haven't given up!!)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
"We're gonna look ahead just like Esc-chi 
and become someone we can be prouder of 
than we are now!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text:
So give it your all, Ace-chan...! As 
our—"Ace"!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Ngh...—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ......Thanks, you two.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I will definitely live up to those words. 
So, let's fight together...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
âIn the classroom bathed in the setting 
sun, that vow echoed quietly, yet with 
undeniable strength.
